name: @gost/svelte
description: Svelte bindings for GOST functional core.

scripts.build: svelte-package -i src && node --input-type=module -e "import { globSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of globSync(['dist/**/*.test.*', 'dist/**/__tests__', '.svelte-kit/__package__'])) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
